main_text.head: ELENCHUS LOCORUM SIVE EXERCITATIONUM, QUÆ in hoc Opere examinantur & disputantur.

page.notes: The title line "QUÆ" carries a ligature over the Q and the first line of the list has the printed Exerc. label in italic. The printed "fol. 1" is the only folio reference given in the list, the rest are bare page numbers. The list is cut off after "13 Utrum" at the foot of the page, so the entry continues beyond this scan. Long s is read as s throughout.
